H1: Whose day is it today? Both of you know.
SUB: The app that organizes your children's time in shared custody: a calendar that mom, dad and every caregiver see the same way, day swaps that only count when both approve, and a history that cannot be edited or deleted.
HERO_TINY: Free for both parents · no credit card · also in the browser, iPhone included · app in English and Portuguese
CAL_MORE: Open the full schedule generator (in Portuguese) →
TRUST: Free plan, no credit card App in English and Portuguese Android and iPhone On Google Play and the web No app store LGPD compliant No ads, no data selling
SCENE_H2: Two homes. One clear path between them.
SCENE_LEAD: The child goes back and forth. What cannot go back and forth is the agreement: whose day each day is, when it changes, and who approved the change. That is what Entrelares keeps — identical for both homes.
WHY_H2: Why not just use a chat app or a spreadsheet?
WHY_LEAD: Because an agreement buried in a conversation turns into an argument: the message gets lost, each of you remembers it differently, and the child is caught in the middle. The app exists to take the schedule out of "nobody told me".
WHY_LIST:
• One calendar, identical for both parents
  • Whose day it is today, always in sight
  • A swap asks for the other parent's approval
  • History with date and time that cannot be deleted
  • Instant notifications — nobody is left out

HOW_LEAD: Each step with a real screen of the app — no staged demo.
S1_H: Create the family and invite the other parent
S1_P: Each of you signs in with your own account. You can also include grandparents and other caregivers who take part in the routine.
S2_P: Set whose day each day is, following your own agreement — alternating weeks, fortnights or a cycle of your own. Holidays and special dates you adjust on the day itself, or on several days at once.
S3_H: Need to swap a day? Propose it in the app
S3_P: The other parent approves or declines, and until they answer the day stays as it was. Everything is recorded, with date and time.
TOUR_H2: Built to reduce conflict, not to be one more app
TOUR_LEAD: Every detail exists to answer one question quickly and prevent one argument. Real screens from the app.
MOD_H3: Beyond the calendar: the child's whole routine
FAM_H2: Two dads, two moms, grandparents, step-parents and the nanny
FAM_LEAD: Each person joins with the role they play in the child's life — 21 built-in ones, or your own on Premium — and whoever only follows along joins as a viewer.
FAM_LINK: See how it works for every family →
QUOTE: "We both needed to know clearly whose day each day was. I tried a spreadsheet, I tried an ordinary calendar. So I built something of my own, something simple, and it grew until it became a true partner in the time I share with my son."
CITE: Irineu — founder of Entrelares, and a father in shared custody
READ_MORE: Read the whole story: why I built Entrelares
INST_H2: Install it on your phone in 30 seconds
INST_LEAD: On Android, get Entrelares on Google Play. On any phone it alsoOn any phone, Entrelares installs straight from the browser and opens like any other app — with an icon on your home screen.
ANDROID_STEPS:
• Go to web.entrelares.app in Chrome.
  • Tap Install when the prompt appears — or open the ⋮ menu and choose Install app.
  • Done: the icon shows up on your home screen, like any other app.
IOS_STEPS:
• Go to web.entrelares.app in Safari.
  • Tap the Share button (the square with an arrow pointing up). If you can’t see it, tap the Page Menu button and choose Share.
  • Scroll the list and tap Add to Home Screen. If it isn’t there, tap Edit Actions at the bottom of the list and add it.
  • Turn on Open as Web App (if you see it), then tap Add. Without it, the icon opens the site in Safari and the app’s notifications never arrive.

TOUR.label: Calendar
TOUR.h: Who has the child, today and across the month
TOUR.p: Open it and see straight away whose day it is — today, tomorrow and across the whole month. A different color for each caregiver, and the next handoff always in sight.
TOUR.alt: App home screen: a card showing whose day it is, and the month calendar with each day colored by parent

TOUR.label: Day by day
TOUR.h: Each day with its caregiver, handoff time and note
TOUR.p: Set who is responsible, the time the child changes homes and a note for each day — the day note is free.
TOUR.alt: The day editor: who is responsible, the handover time and the day note

TOUR.label: Swaps
TOUR.p: A swap becomes a request the other parent approves or declines. No surprises, no "nobody told me".
TOUR.alt: A pending day-swap request with the Approve and Reject buttons

TOUR.label: History
TOUR.p: Every swap, approval and change is recorded with date and time, in a history that cannot be edited or deleted. If what you agreed ever turns into an argument, it's there — in black and white.
TOUR.alt: Change history: an immutable log of every change, with date and time

TOUR.label: Family
TOUR.p: Grandparents, stepparents and other caregivers can join the family and take days, under the same approval rules — each with their own color.
TOUR.alt: A calendar with three caregivers — father, mother and grandmother — each in their own color

TOUR.label: Agenda
TOUR.tag: Day note free · full agenda on Premium
TOUR.h: The child’s agenda, on the right day
TOUR.p: School, health, medicines and activities for each child show up on the calendar day, with the time and who wrote them — and reminders for whoever you choose.
TOUR.alt: The day sheet in the app: the day’s caregiver and the child’s agenda with the school meeting at 6:30 PM

TOUR.label: Expenses
TOUR.h: Who owes what, without a spreadsheet
TOUR.p: Each expense split the way you agreed, with each person’s balance and the fewest payments to settle up. A payment counts only once the person receiving it confirms.
TOUR.alt: The expenses screen in the app: the balance between the caregivers and the list of expenses for the child, each with who paid and the split

TOUR.label: Chat
TOUR.p: Family-only, permanent, with read receipts on every message. What was said stays available, and can go into the PDF report.
TOUR.alt: The family chat in the app: messages between Rafael and Marina with date, time and who has read them

MODULES.tag: Day note free · full agenda on Premium
MODULES.p: School, health, medicines and activities for each child, with routines that repeat and reminders for whoever you choose.
Each expense split equally, by amount, by percentage or by shares, with each person's balance. A payment counts only once the person receiving it confirms — the app never moves money.
One conversation for the whole family that nobody can edit or delete, showing who has read each message.
For people who follow without deciding — a grandparent, a nanny: they see the calendar, the agenda and the reports and get the informative notifications. They change nothing.
The period's report carries a QR code: whoever receives it checks that the file was not altered, and the document is never kept on our servers.
